title: Microwave Surface Resistance in MgB2
abstract: Measurements of the temperature dependence of the surface resistance at 3 GHz of 100 micron size grains of MgB_2 separated powder are presented and discussed. The microwave surface resistance data is compared to experimental results of Nb, Bi_2Sr_2CaCu_2O_{8+δ} (BSCCO) and theoretical predictions of s-wave weak coupling electron-phonon theory (BCS).
